admin.wizard.title: First Launch Wizard
admin.wizard.signed_out: You are not logged in. Log in with the administrator account created during installation.
admin.wizard.compte.title: Your account
admin.wizard.compte.not_admin: Only the administrator account can configure the instance.
admin.wizard.kavita.title: Connect to Kavita
admin.wizard.kavita.admin_warning: Administrator account required: The key that Shelfhold receives from Kavita acts with the rights of this account. Your identifiers are only used to obtain it: they are neither recorded nor stored.
admin.wizard.kavita.accept: I understand: the key will have the rights of a Kavita administrator.
admin.wizard.kavita.done: Kavita is connected. A dedicated key was created; your credentials were not kept.
admin.wizard.dossier.title: Shared folder
admin.wizard.dossier.explain: Shelfhold and Kavita must read the same folder. Shelfhold drops a small test file there, asks Kavita to read it, then removes it.
admin.wizard.dossier.no_destination: No shelves exist yet: create one, then come back here.
admin.wizard.dossier.no_library: The folder is writable. Kavita has no library on it yet: adopt one or create one, then check again.
admin.wizard.dossier.write_failed: Shelfhold cannot write to the shared folder.
admin.wizard.dossier.kavita_failed: Kavita does not read the shared folder. Add this block to your compose file, then run again:
admin.wizard.dossier.preview_result: {series, plural, one {# series} other {# series}} and {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}: nothing is modified until you confirm.
admin.wizard.dossier.verdict.under_libra: Suwayomi downloads into the library: change its download folder, no file is copied.
admin.wizard.dossier.verdict.outside_lib: Suwayomi downloads outside the library: the adopted files will have to be brought back there before removing the direct mounts.
admin.wizard.dossier.adopted: {count, plural, one {# adopted file} other {# adopted files}}; the library is linked.
admin.wizard.etageres.title: Shelves
admin.wizard.etageres.explain: Here are the shelves that Shelfhold creates, each with the phrase that says where the files go.
admin.wizard.etageres.advanced_help: The libraries Kavita already had keep their place; the “Family” shelf is limited to age 13. Everything is adjusted later in the settings.
admin.wizard.sources.title: Sources
admin.wizard.sources.explain: A child searches only in the sources marked “family”. Gutenberg and Wikisource, public domain in the United States, are by default; you can decide otherwise.
admin.wizard.fin.title: Finalization
admin.wizard.fin.book_id: Book number on Gutenberg (public domain in the United States)
admin.wizard.sources.name.gutenberg: Gutenberg (public domain in the United States)
admin.wizard.sources.name.standardebooks: Standard Ebooks (public domain in the United States)
admin.wizard.fin.keyring_help: The keychain protects the secrets of Shelfhold. Without it, a backup is useless: export it, encrypted with a passphrase, and store it away from this server.
admin.wizard.fin.recovery_kit_help: The recovery kit is a page to print: it says how to come back, it holds no secret.
admin.wizard.fin.second_admin_help: Optional: a second administrator can take over if you lose your access.
admin.wizard.fin.finish_blocked: To finish: export the keychain and confirm the jurisdiction.
